The structure of Dy₂Cu₈Ge₄ (Dy(Cu₂Ge)₂) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, Dy centers with 16 neighbors, and Ge centers with 9 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 14 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face contacts between Cu, Dy, and Ge coordination polyhedra.
